pose_carrier_mechanics.role: frame_0 (even index) — pure PoseNet actuator, ZERO semantic content; SegNet never reads it (reads last frame only)

coefficients.coding: per-dimension Rice of delta-zigzag codes, k per dim

decode_recipe_free_generator: per-basis-element zero-mean + unit-RMS normalize  [makes stored codes scale-free -> 5 bits suffice]
coeff = cumsum(unzigzag(delta)) & 0xFFF, sign-corrected, * per-dim fp32 scale
pose_carrier_mechanics.key_structural_fact: The pose actuator is stored on a 24x32 grid (768 px) and bicubic-upsampled twice. PoseNet's 6-dim output is steerable by a 12-dim, very-low-spatial-frequency field. Strong empirical statement about the smoothness of the pose preimage.
pose_carrier_mechanics.temporal_exploit: delta-zigzag + cumsum along the FRAME axis exploits pose-trajectory smoothness; the 12 Rice k values (8-9) are all near-uniform, i.e. per-frame coefficient deltas are ~9-10 bits of genuine entropy each

seg_leg_mechanics.stored_object: the exact 5-class SegNet partition for all 600 scored frames at 384x512 (SegNet's own input grid), losslessly arithmetic-coded
seg_leg_mechanics.prior: IntegerHPAC — patch-group causal AR: Type-A 7x7 / Type-B depthwise dilated masked convs, conv_past prev-frame context, per-frame FiLM (frame_embed 600x8), CausalSPM cross-patch summary
seg_leg_mechanics.group_order: s = c + delta*r with delta=2, patch 64
seg_leg_mechanics.renderer: SemanticTokenRenderer width=96: token_embed(5,96) -> coord_mix(+4 coord channels x,y,x^2,y^2) -> 4 TokenBlocks (depthwise 3x3 dilations 1,1,2,4 + 1x1 + GroupNorm + per-frame FiLM) -> head 3x3 -> sigmoid*255
